fullPassage: Scholars of myth have long argued that myth gives structure and meaning to human life; that meaning is amplified when a myth evolves into a world. A virtual world’s ability to fulfill needs grows when lots and lots of people believe in the world. Conversely, a virtual world cannot be long sustained by a mere handful of adherents. Consider the difference between a global sport and a game I invent with my nine friends and play regularly. My game might be a great game, one that is completely immersive, one that consumes all of my group’s time and attention. If its reach is limited to the ten of us, though, then it’s ultimately just a weird hobby, and it has limited social function. For a virtual world to provide lasting, wide-ranging value, its participants must _____________________________________. When that threshold is reached, psychological value can turn into wide-ranging social value.

questions.passage: Scholars of myth have long argued that myth gives structure and meaning to human life; that meaning is amplified when a myth evolves into a world. A virtual world’s ability to fulfill needs grows when lots and lots of people believe in the world. Conversely, a virtual world cannot be long sustained by a mere handful of adherents. Consider the difference between a global sport and a game I invent with my nine friends and play regularly. My game might be a great game, one that is completely immersive, one that consumes all of my group’s time and attention. If its reach is limited to the ten of us, though, then it’s ultimately just a weird hobby, and __________. For a virtual world to provide lasting, wide-ranging value, its participants must _____________________________________. When that threshold is reached, psychological value can turn into wide-ranging social value.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 제한된 사회적 기능을 가진다 (10명뿐이면 이상한 취미에 불과)
det.analysis:
✅ ① it has limited social function: 원문 일치. 10명에 국한되면 '제한된 사회적 기능' ←정답
❌ ② consumes all time: 시간 소비는 게임의 특성이지 제한의 결과가 아님
❌ ③ meaning is amplified: 의미 증폭은 도입부 내용
❌ ④ cannot be sustained: 유지 불가는 '소수의 추종자'에 대한 내용
det.tip: it's ultimately just a weird hobby, and it has limited social function

ch: it consumes all of my group's time
a virtual world cannot be sustained
